output_list.criticism: The claimTile function is only allowed to be called by currentGameNumber, only claimedBy address can claim tile, this function can be exploited to claim tile for free. This can be achieved by calling the claimTile function from an external contract. The function is payable, which means that it can receive ETH. The claimedBy variable is not used anywhere else in the code. Therefore, the vulnerability is Access Control.
